Subject: Quick 30m deep-dive on your recent usage uptick

Hi Diego —

I noticed BrightPath just crossed one of our high-usage thresholds on the self-serve trial (nice work!). We often see a few quick wins when customers hit this stage — small config and prompt adjustments that cut token spend and latency while keeping output quality.

Would you be open to a short 30-minute technical deep-dive this week where we can:
- Walk through the exact calls that spiked (prefixes, sequence lengths)
- Recommend batching / cache settings and a model-variant that matches your latency/cost targets
- Share a short rollout checklist for predictable scaling

Three quick slots I have open (PT):
• Thu 7/17, 10:00–10:30am PT
• Thu 7/17, 2:00–2:30pm PT
• Fri 7/18, 10:00–10:30am PT

If none of those work, drop a couple times that do and I’ll book. I can pull Camila (solutions engineer) on the call depending on how deep you want to get. Attaching a one-page agenda + a small export of trial usage so you can see what I looked at.

Schedule: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/7890

Thanks — looking forward to helping you dial this in.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
SDR, Redwood Inference
